why: Google Maps (read 2026-11-12) marks North Gold RV Park, 9551 103rd St NW, Columbus, 'Permanently closed', with no website, 3 reviews from 7-8 years ago (one: 'No such place. Bogus empty lot'), and posting turned off. It is on neither RV Life nor Good Sam (Algolia indexes, 2026-11-12). The only other traces are an expired 2013 RVParkStore for-sale listing (20 full-hookup lots, built 2013 for the Bakken oil boom, 'average lot rent $650', which reads as monthly) and an unreviewed The Dyrt stub pinned 68 km away. So it has neither a price indicator nor a presence indicator, and a satellite look at Google's pin (Esri, 2026-11-12) shows a shop yard and a farmstead with no laid-out RV pads. The HHS listing alone does not make a live campground.
name: North Gold RV Park
flags: The ND HHS 07.17.2025 list still licenses it for 20 units, while Google calls it permanently closed. The 2013 listing points to an oil-patch monthly crew park, and no nightly rate was found anywhere.
